invariants: A provider outage must map to affected customer projects before impact is represented as known
Critical dependencies without a verified fallback must surface REVIEW or HOLD
Fallback existence is not enough; fallback readiness must be evidenced
Provider risk assessment must not auto-switch provider or mutate Production
Customer notification requires separate communication authority
Unknown or stale dependency ownership returns REVIEW
Secrets, API keys and credentials must never be stored in the dependency register
Third-party contractual or data-residency obligations must be recorded where relevant
A single provider may have different criticality across different customer projects
Provider health evidence and project impact evidence must be kept distinct
